name: Linear
desc: Issue tracking for modern software teams

actions.name: linear_create_issue
actions.description: Create an issue in a Linear team.

actions.name: linear_update_issue
actions.description: Change an issue. Only the fields you fill in are changed.

actions.name: linear_create_project
actions.description: Create a project in a Linear team.

actions.name: linear_update_project
actions.description: Change a project. Only the fields you fill in are changed.

actions.name: linear_create_comment
actions.description: Post a comment on an issue.

actions.name: linear_get_issue
actions.description: Get an issue by its key, such as ENG-123, or its ID.

actions.name: linear_search_issues
actions.description: Search issue titles and descriptions for your words.

actions.name: linear_add_label_to_issue
actions.description: Add one label to an issue and keep its other labels

actions.name: linear_remove_label_from_issue
actions.description: Remove one label from an issue and keep its other labels

actions.name: linear_delete_issue
actions.description: Move an issue to the trash. Linear keeps it for 30 days, so it can be restored.

actions.name: linear_attach_link
actions.description: Link a URL to an issue. Attaching it again updates that link.

actions.name: linear_create_project_status_update
actions.description: Post a status update, with an optional health rating, on a project.

actions.name: rawGraphqlQuery
actions.description: Send any GraphQL query or mutation to the Linear API.

triggers.name: new_comment
triggers.description: Triggers when someone comments on an issue in a public team.

triggers.name: new_issue
triggers.description: Triggers when an issue is created in the selected team.

triggers.name: updated_issue
triggers.description: Triggers when an issue changes. Pick a team to include a private one.

triggers.name: removed_issue
triggers.description: Triggers when an issue in the selected team is deleted.

triggers.name: new_project
triggers.description: Triggers when a project is created in a public team.

triggers.name: updated_project
triggers.description: Triggers when a project in a public team changes status.

triggers.name: removed_project
triggers.description: Triggers when a project in a public team is deleted.

triggers.name: new_project_status_update
triggers.description: Triggers when an update is posted on a project in a public team.
